title: Who an MF distributor is: ARN, EUIN and the limits
objectives: State what an ARN and an EUIN are and who needs them.
Explain why a distributor is not a SEBI Registered Investment Adviser.
Describe yourself correctly to a client.
body_md:
A trainee must be able to explain, in two minutes, who holds the client's money, who regulates it, and where Fund Horizon fits.

## Who an MF distributor is

- Registered with AMFI and holds an ARN (AMFI Registration Number), renewed periodically.
- Each person who deals with clients needs NISM Series V-A certification and an EUIN (Employee Unique Identification Number), quoted on every transaction they handle.
- A distributor is not a SEBI Registered Investment Adviser (RIA). Distributors can give guidance incidental to selling products but cannot charge an advisory fee, and should describe themselves as a "Mutual Fund Distributor", not an "independent adviser".
example: A client asks you to draw up a full financial plan for ₹5,000. You explain that distributors cannot charge an advisory fee, and offer guidance that is part of selling products, or refer them to a SEBI-registered adviser for a paid plan.
say: I am a Mutual Fund Distributor, registered with AMFI. My ARN is on every document.
For a paid financial plan, a SEBI-registered investment adviser is the right person.
never: I'll charge you a fee for this advice.

check.q: Which body registers mutual fund distributors and issues the ARN?
check.why: AMFI is the industry body that registers distributors (ARN). SEBI is the regulator.

o: Only the head of the distribution firm
Only employees handling lump sums above ₹1 lakh
Every employee who deals with clients
check.why: Each person dealing with clients needs NISM Series V-A and an EUIN, quoted on every transaction they handle.

check.q: A distributor wants to charge a client ₹5,000 for a financial plan. What is correct?
o: Not allowed; charging for advice requires SEBI RIA registration
Allowed once a year at the annual review
check.why: Distributors give guidance incidental to selling and cannot charge an advisory fee or call themselves independent advisers.
